cli_options.description: List of command-line options (strings) to pass to cmigemo. Each item must be a valid CLI argument as per cmigemo(1). Order matters. Valid items: -d|--dict <file>, -s|--subdict <file>, -q|--quiet, -v|--vim, -e|--emacs, -n|--nonewline, -w|--word <word>, -h|--help. Only documented options allowed; no custom flags. Max 8 -s subdicts per manual. Must not contain invalid combinations (e.g., -w requires <word>). Every option used must be representable as a single string per list item (e.g., "-d /path/to/dict").
